title.value: A modified Thompson sampling-based learning algorithm for unknown linear systems
title.justification: The title "A modified Thompson sampling-based learning algorithm for unknown linear systems" indicates the core subject of the paper, which is a study on a modified Thompson sampling algorithm for controlling linear systems with unknown parameters.
title.quote: A modified Thompson sampling-based learning algorithm for unknown linear systems

analysis.description: This paper addresses a modification of the Thompson Sampling-based learning algorithm applied to controlling unknown linear systems with quadratic cost. The modification introduces lower bounds on episode length to ensure improved regret bounds under milder assumptions.

type.justification: The paper presents a modification and theoretical analysis of an existing algorithm (Thompson Sampling) for better regret bounds, rather than conducting experiments or empirical analysis.
type.quote: In this paper, we revisit a recently proposed algorithm for establishing Bayesian regret called Thompson sampling with dynamic episodes (TSDE) [1].

name.justification: The research is centered on learning optimal policies for unknown linear systems, which is a typical problem within the domain of reinforcement learning.
name.quote: The problem of learning an optimal policy for a system with linear dynamics and quadratic cost with unknown parameters has received considerable attention in the literature.

name.justification: The paper applies reinforcement learning techniques to control problems involving linear systems.
name.quote: In recent years, the emphasis has shifted towards developing algorithms with finite-time regret guarantees.
